paper.title: Nonparametric Pricing Analytics with Customer Covariates

unmapped: Action is a price p in [0,1]; reward Z_t = p_t * Bernoulli(d(X_t,p_t)), expected revenue f(x,p)=p d(x,p)
Covariates X_t i.i.d. in [0,1)^d with arbitrary distribution; f is nonparametric in x
f Lipschitz in x and p with constant M_1 (Assumption 2)

For every hyper-rectangle B, f_B(p)=E[f(X,p)|X in B] has a unique maximizer with quadratic growth M_2 (p*-p)^2 <= f_B(p*)-f_B(p) <= M_3 (p*-p)^2; p*(B) lies in the range of p*(x) over B; the range of p*(x) over B is at most M_4 diam(B) (Assumption 3)
Learner knows constants M_1..M_4 (only M_2 actually used)
settings.definition_quote: In period $t\in\left\{1,2,\dots,T\right\}$, a customer arrives with covariate $\bm X_t$. Upon observing $\bm X_t$, the firm sets a price $p_t$. The revenue earned in period $t$ is denoted by $Z_t$ where $Z_t/p_t$ is a Bernoulli random variable with mean $d(\bm X_t,p_t)$, independent of everything else. ... $R_{\pi}(T) = \sum_{t=1}^T \E\left[(f^{\ast}(\bm X_t)-f(\bm X_t,p_t))\right]$.

conditions: f satisfies Assumption 2 (Lipschitz with M_1) and Assumption 3 (unique maximizer with quadratic growth M_2, M_3; maximizer containment; M_4 continuity of optimal price)
tuning: n_k = max{0, ceil(2^{4k+15}/(M_2^2 log^3 T) (log T + log log T - (d+2) k log 2))}

source.label: thm:upper-bound
source.quote: For any function $f$ satisfying Assumption~\ref{asp:lipschitz} and~\ref{asp:maximizer}, the regret incurred by the ABE algorithm is bounded by \begin{equation*} R_{\pi_{ABE}}(T)\le C T^{ \frac{2+d}{4+d}}\log(T)^2 \end{equation*} for a constant $C>0$ that is independent of $T$.

results.notes: Constant C depends on d and M_1..M_4. Regret defined via expected revenue gap f*(X_t)-f(X_t,p_t), so pseudo-regret against per-context optimal price. Proof uses T >= max{exp(8 M_4 sqrt(d)), exp(4 sqrt(2M_3/M_2))}.

conditions: constructed class C of f_w indexed by w in {0,1}^{M^d} with M = ceil(T^{1/(d+4)}), satisfying Assumptions 2 and 3 with M_1=4, M_2=1, M_3=2, M_4=1

source.label: thm:lower-bound
source.quote: For the constructed $\mathcal C$, any non-anticipating policy $\pi$ has regret \begin{equation*} \sup_{f\in \mathcal C}R_\pi(T)\ge c T^{\frac{2+d}{4+d}} \end{equation*} for a constant $c>0$.

results.notes: Minimax lower bound via KL / Tsybakov-style construction (similar to Rigollet & Zeevi). Lemmas 3 and 4 are intermediate steps.

cited_results.setting_description: Contextual bandits with Lipschitz expected reward f(x,p) on Euclidean covariate space of dimension d_x=d and decision dimension d_p=1 (no smoothness/local concavity)
